visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a high-angle shot of two stainless steel pet bowls placed on a light beige tiled floor. A brown and white Corgi stands near the bowls, staring up at the camera with an expectant expression and slightly tilted head. The indoor environment is brightly lit. (2) A person's hand enters from the bottom right, pointing at the bowls. A second Corgi, with lighter markings, approaches from the right. Both dogs are now focused on the person, with their mouths open in a playful, expectant manner and tails wagging out of frame. (3) The camera follows the person's hand as it opens a white storage drawer. Inside, a yellow bag of Pedigree dog food, red scissors, and several green dental treats are visible. The person selects two treat sticks and holds them out for the dogs to see. (4) The owner holds the treats high above the dogs. The Corgis track the movement of the hand with intense focus, their heads moving in unison. The background reveals a cluttered storage or shop area with various boxes, crates, and white sacks. (5) A close-up shows one Corgi barking on command, its mouth wide and eyes bright. The owner then lowers his hand to give the treats. Both dogs take their respective rewards gently. (6) The video concludes with the two Corgis lying on the tiled floor, happily chewing on their green treats. The owner reaches down and pets the head of the closer dog in a warm, affectionate gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A man's voice enters immediately, speaking in an upbeat, high-energy Traditional Chinese dialect. He is clearly addressing the dogs in a playful and friendly manner. The background is a very quiet indoor room tone. (2) A sharp mechanical sliding sound is heard as the owner pulls open a drawer. This is followed by the high-frequency rustling of a plastic bag as he retrieves the treats. The man continues talking, his pitch rising with excitement. (3) A distinct, resonant bark from one of the Corgis breaks the speech. It is a high-arousal sound. The owner laughs lightly and responds with encouraging words. The sound of the drawer closing with a soft thud is audible. (4) The man's voice shifts to a lower, calmer tone as he praises the dogs. The faint sounds of the dogs' mouths snapping as they catch the treats can be heard, followed by soft, rhythmic chewing sounds. (5) The audio ends with the man's soothing voice and the gentle friction sound of his hand stroking the dog's fur, accompanied by the dogs' happy panting.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a charming and relatable interaction between a pet owner and two Corgis, focusing on the dogs' obedience and excitement during their daily treat routine.
